spec_items.title: Focus the viewport when closing a dialog without previous focus
spec_items.body: When a dialog closes without a previously focused element, its current focus can remain inside the closed dialog until the asynchronous focus fixup runs. Focus the document's viewport synchronously if focus is still inside the dialog; leave focus elsewhere alone.
